## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, see CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes (and `pnpm release` and `pnpm build:website` for pack, script or docs changes).
- [ ] Changes to the engine or a pack come with a conformance case.

**For pack content:**

- [ ] It comes from an openly licensed source, named here: <!-- source -->
- [ ] No rules text from a game that isn't openly licensed; mechanics-only packs get no prose.
- [ ] No setting proper nouns or publisher trademarks in IDs, names or text.
- [ ] Player-facing text is in `i18n/`, not next to the mechanics.
